highlights: from day one. This role is built for a strong operations leader who is ready to run a full building, prove it across the network, and grow toward site leadership. If you thrive on variety, build trust fast in new environments, and want a clear path to owning a building's operation, this is your role. How will you achieve success: Making Safety Non-Negotiable: Hold the safety standard at every site you support. Quickly assess conditions in new environments, hold Area Managers accountable through leading indicators, drive engineering and ergonomic fixes, and treat near-misses as learning opportunities. Running the Building: Own facility performance at every site you support across Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost. Run the operation through standard work and your leadership team, not by being in the execution path yourself. In crisis deployments, lead the turnaround alongside the Site Director. In stable periods, raise the bar. Financial Ownership: Understand facility and network P&L, discuss controllable lines in dollars, and find and close financial bleeds in the FC process. Identify trends, opportunities, and threats before they're escalated to you. Network Deployment & Crisis Response: Travel a minimum of 25% of the time, and potentially more, to assigned and activated facilities across the Spreetail network. When a site becomes a focus, you and your team go there. When the network is stable, you're building for the future. Capacity & Labor Planning: Read data forward to anticipate volume swings from domestic and international inbound freight. Plan capacity, space, and hiring for the season, model the cost, and prepare the facility to maintain 100% on-time shipping execution. Building the Bench: Directly develop Area Managers and FC Leads on the Away Team. Own individual development plans, delegate with follow-up, and build a record of promoting talent from the hourly ranks. Foster a culture of growth that travels with the team. Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with People & Culture, Transportation, Vendor Management, and HQ teams to align site operations with Spreetail's supply chain strategy, moving peers and partners forward without direct authority over them. Future FC Placement: Prepare to transition into a permanent senior operations leadership role at a new Spreetail fulfillment center. This placement is a core part of this role's purpose and your career trajectory with Spreetail. Placement timing is determined by Spreetail's network expansion plans. What experiences will help you in this role: Experienced: 5+ years in fulfillment, manufacturing, or distribution (e-commerce preferred). Proven Leader: 5+

To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location. Our Operations workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customers door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer. Key Responsibilities and Job Elements: - Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce - Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact - Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance - Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises - Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives - Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach - Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts - Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud - Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments) - Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs) Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business current openings.
